description: This file contains assembly code for flushing the data cache (D-cache) on ARMv7 architecture, specifically for Broadcom devices. It includes functions for globally flushing the entire D-cache, handling cache level traversal, and performing set/way invalidation.

methods.name: v7_flush_dcache_all
methods.description: Function to flush the entire data cache on ARMv7 platforms. Implements entering a cache level traversal loop, and performs set/way invalidation using set/way indices.
